status_effects.explanation: Her charm is affirmed but simultaneously reframed by the narrator as a marker of intellectual and emotional limitation, producing a mildly diminishing, mixed local appraisal.
The narrator's exposure strips away Bréauté's self-presentation as authentically indifferent to society, revealing calculated snobbery beneath it.
He is publicly showcased by the duchess as a literary connoisseur in front of her guests, a modest local elevation of his standing within her circle.

appraisal_events.evidence: la pureté même du langage de la duchesse était un signe de limitation, et qu'en elle, et l'intelligence et la sensibilité étaient restées fermées à toutes les nouveautés... elle était incapable de comprendre ce que j'avais cherché en elle
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator finds Mme de Guermantes' speech and charm genuinely appealing, but explicitly frames that same purity as proof her intelligence and sensibility are closed to anything new, and notes she cannot grasp what he actually sought from her.

appraisal_events.evidence: Sa haine des snobs découlait de son snobisme, mais faisait croire aux naïfs, c'est-à-dire à tout le monde, qu'il en était exempt.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator directly exposes Bréauté's professed contempt for society and snobs as itself a calculated form of snobbery, undercutting his self-fashioned image of disinterested intellectual authenticity.

appraisal_events.evidence: Vous devez savoir tous les noms, me dit-elle avec une envie sincère pour mes relations poétiques et aussi par amabilité à mon « égard », pour poser davantage aux yeux de ses invités un jeune homme aussi versé dans la littérature.
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme de Guermantes singles the narrator out before her assembled guests as a young man deeply versed in literature, staging his inclusion as a valued, knowledgeable presence in her salon, even if partly to enhance her own display.
